text.p: LogiMetrics Inc on Tuesday said it entered a preliminary agreement with MBF Capital Corp for $1.5 million in financing.
MBF Capital is controlled by Mark B. Fisher, a former director of the company, it said.

The agreement calls for MBF to form a limited partnership to purchase $1.25 million of convertible senior subordinated debentures and warrants entitling it to purchase 3.75 million shares of the LogiMetrics' common stock for a total purchase price of $1.5 million.

LogiMetrics said the debentures, maturing in December 31, 1998, would pay 12 percent interest at a rate of 12 percent a year, subject to adjustment in certain circumstances. The debentures will be convertible into an aggregate of 3.0 million shares, subject to certain anti-dilution adjustments.

Fisher will have the right to appoint one member of the LogiMetrics board so long as the debentures are outstanding or the partnership owns at least 7.5 percent of the company's outstanding common stock.
